proposals.name: DayOne Kiveriö Lahti campus

fresh_physical_source.literal_pointer: Visible August 2026 site bulletin under job 2984; literal HTML string offset about 324129 identifies the date, followed by current frame-work paragraph.
fresh_physical_source.factual_extraction: SRV reports current construction at Ilmarisentie 3 and framework roughly halfway complete. Expected framework completion at August end remains future. The main project page binds job 2984, Lahti/Kiveriö, DayOne and the address.
fresh_physical_source.date_limitation: The bulletin section is labelled Viikko 32 but explicitly dated 11.08.2026, which is ISO week 33. Preserve the discrepancy; August report freshness is clear but do not turn the week label into a separate exact work-event date.
fresh_physical_source.status_scope: Authoritative recent under-construction evidence is available; no normalized lifecycle/admission is written while exact locator remains unresolved.
fresh_physical_source.rights_scope: No open SRV-content licence asserted. Compact restated facts only; raw publisher body and imagery remain temporary.

locator_review.finding: Exact DayOne Lahti query returns no results.

City article identifies datacenter permit applicant Kiinteistö Oy Lahden Ilmarisentie 3 and actual construction address Väinämöisentie 2 a, Kiveriö, with old industrial buildings to be demolished. It does not literally name DayOne; further parcel-to-project bridge would need review.

Owner's JSON-LD coordinates are areaServed GeoCircle geoMidpoint for Northern Europe/continental European markets, not site geometry; rejected despite geographic plausibility.

proposals.successor_context: August site bulletin describes ongoing frame work; main contractor page's 2027 operation remains forecast. Existing industrial buildings and a wholesale business are not data-center operation. No new campus is created for contractor job number or planned phases.
